# Kristian Garza

> I'm a Berlin-based AI engineer. My skill set includes robust research capabilities, prototyping, and coding, all aimed at crafting empowering and intuitive user experiences. I specialize in leveraging the intersection of design and AI to address real-world challenges.

Kristian Garza is a Senior AI Engineer at Digital Science (ORCID: 0000-0003-3484-6875).

- Currently: Building and prototyping AI-driven microservices and agents at Digital Science, from LLM-powered APIs to Rust-based clustering engines.
- Previously: Developed core infrastructure at DataCite, including Commons, Fabrica, and Sashimi, while leading metadata and design system initiatives.
- Find me: Hosting DS’s AI Technology Radar sessions and experimenting with personal AI projects like a Dataset Discovery & Evaluation Agent.
- Contact: kj.garza+kjgarza@gmail.com | GitHub: https://github.com/kjgarza | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kjgarza

Case studies marked with a `.md` link have a plain-markdown mirror at `<page-url>index.md`. Pages without one are password-protected; contact the author for access. The complete public content of this site is concatenated in [llms-full.txt](https://kjgarza.github.io/llms-full.txt).

## Work

- [Harmonizing with a Design System](https://kjgarza.github.io/work/creating-a-design-system/index.md): DataCite — Crafted a Design System for all DataCite frontend services.
- [DataCite Usage Reports API - Research Data Metrics at Scale](https://kjgarza.github.io/work/datacite-usage-reports-api/index.md): DataCite — Designed and delivered Sashimi—a Rails API that ingests, validates, and stores large SUSHI usage reports in S3/MySQL at 50,000-dataset scale with JWT security and on-the-fly compression.
- [Innovating Data Usage Processing Services](https://kjgarza.github.io/work/innovating-data-usage-processing-services/index.md): DataCite — Pioneering an alternative to existing data usage processing services through web tracker development.
- [Knowledge Graph Engine - Company Knowledge as a Graph for AI Agents](https://kjgarza.github.io/work/knowledge-graph-engine/): Digital Science — Architected a hexagonal Effect-TS pipeline that extracts a Postgres-backed knowledge graph from company documents and serves it to AI agents over MCP. (password-protected)
- [Query Translation API - Natural Language to Database Queries](https://kjgarza.github.io/work/query-translation-api/): Digital Science — Architected and launched a FastAPI microservice that turns natural-language requests into optimized Dimensions searches via LLM entity extraction and pgvector semantic search. (password-protected)
- [Redesigning DataCite's Harvesting Services](https://kjgarza.github.io/work/redesigning-datacite-harvesting-services/index.md): DataCite — Redesigned DataCite's Harvesting Services from the ground up to boost service utilization and unlock new revenue opportunities through user-centered design research.
- [Repo Atlas - Making 1,000+ Repos Discoverable with LLMs](https://kjgarza.github.io/work/repo-atlas-catalogue/): Digital Science — Built an LLM-powered catalogue that scans an entire GitHub org and answers "does a repo already exist that does X?" through an MCP server and web UI. (password-protected)

## Tools

- [Dataset Discovery Agent](https://hawfinch.vercel.app/): An AI agent automating discovery, evaluation, and acquisition of open research datasets for scientists and data engineers.
- [SnowyOwl](https://github.com/kjgarza/snowyowl): An asynchronous AI development tool where you write task specifications and receive completed pull requests overnight — delegation without presence.
- [Technology Radar](https://kjgarza.github.io/radar): A personal technology radar that categorizes tools, frameworks, and techniques into Adopt, Trial, and other tiers — separating what's genuinely useful from what's just hype.
- [Parrot GPT](https://github.com/kjgarza/parrot-gpt): A Python toolkit that uses GPT-3/3.5 to translate, enrich, and cross-walk bibliographic metadata across schemas, with CLI and CI/CD support.
- [Election Program AI Analyser](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-678bbfd0f3388191b253ef5725e242e0-bundestags-wahlnavigator-2025): An AI-powered tool that simplifies 2025 Bundestag election programs, giving clear answers to voters’ policy questions in natural language.
- [CrossFit WOD Viewer](https://kjgarza.github.io/oxypogon/): A web app that scrapes CrossFit workout-of-the-day data and uses AI to provide explanations, scaling options, and beginner-friendly modifications.
- [Kitchen Timer](https://kjgarza.github.io/chickadee/): A mobile-optimized cooking app that uses GPT vision to extract structured data from recipe photos, with an action-first UI designed to reduce cognitive load in the kitchen.
